title: SEC4: Improve variable naming: 'hhmm' should be 'time_hhmm' or 'hour_minute'
description: Lines 318, 487, etc. use cryptic 'hhmm' variable for time string. Better names: hour_minute, time_display, or time_hhmm. Also note that [11..16] slice comment explaining RFC 3339 format extraction would help readers understand the intent.
